name: @arche-sh/piflow
description: Unified pi extension. Autonomous engineering skill framework (public skills plus maintainer opt-ins) plus the `delegate` role primitive (explore, session-miner) in one npm package. Successor to the separately-shipped pi-dev (skills) and pi-role (delegate)
